name: S03_waves

camera.move: static then very slight push-in on the shout

action_beats.what: Both at the cliff edge, side by side, looking at the horizon
Keeper long pause, then quietly agrees
Both lean forward and shout at the sea (comic, not realistic)
A small wave actually rolls in; terrier triumphant, keeper annoyed it worked

dialog.line: If we shout loud enough, will the tide come early?

audio.music: short triumphant toot then dry stinger

continuity.in: from S02: both outside walking toward the cliff

compiled_prompt: Plasticine stop-motion. Tall lanky clay lighthouse keeper in yellow raincoat and short round clay terrier in green hat and red scarf stand side by side at a cliff edge above the sea, looking at the horizon. Overcast coastal light, wind. The terrier leans forward and says in a quick high voice: "If we shout loud enough, will the tide come early?" The keeper pauses, then says quietly: "No. But we can try." Both lean forward and give a comic shout at the sea. A small wave rolls in. The terrier looks triumphant; the keeper looks mildly annoyed that it worked. Slightly stepped stop-motion, static camera then slight push-in. Audio: clear voices, wind, wave at the end, short triumphant toot then dry stinger.
